about: TCS I/O list of LMYP Unit 1 (lane 2 TCS IO). rows = the PI/O tables TCE9xx / TCA9xx of the soft logic set (331DM09784 / 09788, typed from the drawing), one per card channel; pin = the logic sheet(s) printing the reference of the row (or, on the builder sheets, the box with its name); spareBox = PI/O boxes the sheets draw as SPARE; tag / from / dcsSh / ibd = the matched row of XSMM_IO_List_R1.xlsx "IO LIST R.1 (3)" (iolist-tcs.zip). Made by tools/data/tcs_io.mjs. The model or HMI end of each row is in src/digital/tce-io.js.
